title: Specifications for the Interconnection of a Host and an IMP

claims_extracted.claim: Report 1822 defines the standard Host-IMP attachment boundary for ARPANET and includes physical/electrical, readiness, and message-access behavior.

claims_extracted.notes: Do not apply 1976 values automatically to the September 1969 installation.
